newsitem.title: LEBANON: Active shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Active shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Active shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday with four shares steady, two up and one bank share slightly down.
The three listed bank shares were mixed with Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce up to $15.75 from $15.625, Banque Audi steady at $20 and Bank of Beirut down to $3.5 from $3.5625.
Demand exceeded supply for the three shares.

"Holders of these shares are not speculators. They are not willing to buy and sell. This is why there is not enough supply. Demand remains high because of the perception that the shares are doing well," dealer Carole Dib of Credit Commercial et Foncier told Reuters.
Newcomer Bank of Beirut fell on Wednesday by 1.7 percent for the first time since its spectacular debut on April 11.
"It's a small correction and it's normal. It's a temporary period of profit-taking," Dib added.
Demand for the Bank of Beirut remained high with 563,110 orders against Wednesday's 399,390 and supply was 528,585 shares compared with 578,129. Turnover was 399,486 shares from 310,501.
Some 10,128 Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares traded on the floor at $15.625.
The LIBX bank index fell 0.32 percent to 134.5. The BLOM general index rose 0.3 percent to 914.22 and the LISPI rose 0.14 percent to 87.18.
Ciments Libanais rose to $1.2812 from $1.25 on turnover of 19,700 shares against Wednesday's 500 shares.
Pipemaker Eternit was unchanged at $2 from $1.9375 on turnover of 3,088 shares from 26,500 a day earlier.
Solidere A and B shares were unchanged at $10.25 and $10.75 respectively.
Total BSE turnover was 562,372 shares against Wednesday's 514,749 shares and value was $3,148,330 from $3,075,143.
There was no trade in Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic .
